Per the 28 November 2017 version of the Fedora API spec, section 3.3 HTTP HEAD:

"... the server SHOULD send the same headers in response to a HEAD request as it would have sent if the request had been a GET, except that the payload headers (defined in [RFC7231] section 3.3) MAY be omitted."
According to the HTTP 1.1 spec (RFC 7231), section 3.3, Payload semantics, the following response headers are considered payload headers:
..and so may be omitted from HEAD responses.
The following test shows that a HEAD response to a resource omits the headers "Vary:" and "Preference-Applied:", which are returned by a GET request to the same resource.
According to the specification, the HEAD response should also return the Vary and Preference-Applied headers.

renderedFields.description:
Per the 28 November 2017 version of the Fedora API spec, section 3.3 HTTP HEAD:

"... the server SHOULD send the same headers in response to a HEAD request as it would have sent if the request had been a GET, except that the payload headers (defined in [RFC7231] section 3.3) MAY be omitted."

According to the HTTP 1.1 spec (RFC 7231), section 3.3, Payload semantics, the following response headers are considered payload headers:

  • Content-Length
  • Content-Range
  • Trailer
  • Transfer-Encoding

..and so may be omitted from HEAD responses.

The following test shows that a HEAD response to a resource omits the headers "Vary:" and "Preference-Applied:", which are returned by a GET request to the same resource.

$ curl -i -X GET -u fedoraAdmin:secret3 http://localhost:9090/fcrepo5/rest
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: Apache-Coyote/1.1
Cache-Control: private
Expires: Wed, 31 Dec 1969 18:00:00 CST
ETag: W/"94af9943465b8fc32f09f62ee1a45ca44ef9ccec"
Last-Modified: Tue, 28 Nov 2017 23:15:01 GMT
Link: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#Resource>;rel="type"
Link: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#Container>;rel="type"
Link: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#BasicContainer>;rel="type"
Link: <http://localhost:9090/fcrepo5/static/constraints/ContainerConstraints.rdf>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#constrainedBy"
Accept-Patch: application/sparql-update
Accept-Post: text/turtle,text/rdf+n3,text/n3,application/rdf+xml,application/n-triples,application/ld+json,multipart/form-data,application/sparql-update,message/external-body; access-type=URL
Allow: MOVE,COPY,DELETE,POST,HEAD,GET,PUT,PATCH,OPTIONS
Preference-Applied: return=representation
Vary: Prefer
Vary: Accept, Range, Accept-Encoding, Accept-Language
Content-Type: text/turtle;charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 1545
Date: Fri, 08 Dec 2017 22:06:29 GMT

@prefix premis: <http://www.loc.gov/premis/rdf/v1#> .
@prefix test: <info:fedora/test/> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
[...]

$ curl -i -X HEAD -u fedoraAdmin:secret3 http://localhost:9090/fcrepo5/rest
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: Apache-Coyote/1.1
Cache-Control: private

Allow: MOVE,COPY,DELETE,POST,HEAD,GET,PUT,PATCH,OPTIONS

According to the specification, the HEAD response should also return the Vary and Preference-Applied headers.
